title: Test: did the notification work?
ask: Did a notification arrive on your phone, and did tapping it open this screen?
details:
This checks the whole loop: Claude writes a question → Gemini's script sends it → your phone buzzes → you tap an answer → Claude reads it.

**YES** = all worked. **NO** = something didn't (add a note: no buzz, or the tap opened the wrong screen).

title: Ship the parent-consent screens (row X)?
ask: Students who signed up alone see "Ask a parent or guardian" until a parent links them or they join a class. Plus College / grown-up and "say it appreciate". Ship it?
details:
**What changes for kids:** a student with no parent linked and no class sees only the "Ask a parent or guardian" screen: send a WhatsApp message to the parent, type the parent's code, or join a class with a code. Nothing is saved before a parent says yes (India's DPDP Act and Google Play's family rules).

**Your 3 yeses are in:** College / grown-up (year of birth, 18+ skips the gate), "parent or guardian" wording, sign-in says "appreciate" out loud once.

**Before it ships:** link Pratha to your account (Me → Link my child's own account), or she sees the gate too. Gemini's test account Sam also gets the gate (good: it tests it).

**YES** = Claude merges and publishes to everyone on 20.0.30. Mockup: rows X1–X5 on the canvas (link above).

title: The one old student with no parent
ask: One account (Class 5, signed up April 2025) has no parent linked. Delete it only if no parent says yes within 14 days after the gate ships?
details:
Found by Gemini (G45). After the gate ships, this child sees "Ask a parent or guardian" on their next open. If nobody says yes in 14 days, the account and its data are deleted (same deletion as "Delete my account").

**YES** = wait 14 days, then delete. **NO** = keep it (say why in the note).

title: Store name and text
ask: Use "Apprec8: Learn & Grow", the short description "Fun, calm daily learning for Classes 1–12: English, Science and more. No ads." and feature graphic draft 2?
details:
The full description is in My notes → Store listing. It starts "Apprec8 (say it "appreciate") helps children learn a little every day…" and lists subjects as "English and Science today, with Maths and reasoning coming next".

![Feature graphic](https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/mohitcnsia/images@main/apprec8-feature-graphic-draft2.png)

**YES** = paste it into Play Console (Store listing). **MORE DETAILS** = Claude explains or changes it.
